hero_headline: Built for High-Volume Streamers & Media Teams
hero_sub: The complete technical pipeline designed to turn hours of live VODs into high-converting Shorts without timeline editing.

pillars.title: Automated Peak Detection
pillars.body: Scans chat velocity, emote surges, YouTube Most Replayed heatmaps, and audio amplitude to catch top moments instantly.

pillars.title: Intelligent 9:16 Framing
pillars.body: Auto-detects active facecams and locks game focus. Apply preset templates for facecam-top, full-screen, or split-screen layouts.

pillars.title: Kinetic Caption Engine
pillars.body: Generate high-accuracy subtitles with dynamic word highlights, custom font uploads, and brand color presets.

pillars.title: Multi-Account Dispatch
pillars.body: Schedule and push clips directly to TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels with custom title & hashtag presets.

specs.label: Captions Support
specs.value: Custom fonts (.TTF/.OTF), animated kinetic styles, 20+ languages
